dm_enable_discount_desc: Goes live instantly on the customer app the moment you save
dm_step1_text: Tap Create Discount for a guided form, or Custom Discount to build one freely. Add a title, real photo, and description — customers see all of this on the offers page.
dm_step2_text: Specific items, a whole category, a combo of 2+ items at a fixed price, or the entire order (storewide, with an optional minimum cart value).
dm_step3_text: Percentage off, flat amount off, or a fixed combo price. Optionally restrict it to a date range, time window (e.g. 4–7pm happy hour), and specific days of the week.
dm_step4_text: The moment you save (or toggle Live/Off), the change is pushed in real time over a live connection to every customer's app and your dashboard — no refresh needed.
dm_step5_text: When a customer's cart matches a live offer, the discounted price is calculated automatically at checkout — item, category, combo, and storewide offers all stack correctly.
dm_step6_text: Edit the pencil icon to change details, toggle Live/Off to pause without losing the offer, or delete permanently with the trash icon. Expired or scheduled offers are labelled automatically.
dm_tip: Tip: Add a real photo to every offer — offers with photos get far more taps on the customer app than plain text banners.

dm_scope_storewide_desc: Discount applies to the whole order
